status.defaultPrompt: Every day at 10am, search for the latest AI news, summarize and output an insight report. (Please use the /cron skill to create a scheduled task in CSBU WorkMate.)

confirmDeleteWithConversations: Are you sure you want to delete this scheduled task? All conversations from this task will also be deleted.

detail.executionModeDescriptionNew: Each run starts a fresh conversation, so previous context does not carry over. Best for recurring reports or checks that should stay independent.
detail.executionModeDescriptionExisting: Each run continues in the same conversation, so earlier context and results stay available. Best for follow-up tasks that build on previous runs.

page.description: Run tasks on a schedule. You can also ask CSBU WorkMate in any conversation to create one for you.
page.awakeBanner: Scheduled tasks only run while your computer is awake.
page.keepAwakeTooltip: When enabled, CSBU WorkMate will prevent your computer from going to sleep
page.scheduleHint: Scheduled tasks use a randomized delay of several minutes for server performance.
page.customCronWarning: This task has a custom schedule that can't be edited here. Changing the frequency will replace it.

form.name: Name
form.promptPlaceholder: Instructions for the assistant to execute
form.queueHint: When enabled, a new trigger is skipped while the previous scheduled conversation is still running, without interrupting the assistant.
form.agentPlaceholder: Select the assistant to execute this task
form.assistantPlaceholder: Select the assistant to execute this task
form.executionModeEditHint: Execution mode cannot be changed after creation. Delete and recreate the task to switch modes.
form.workspaceHint: Optional: set a project folder for file operations
form.aionrsModelRequired: Please select a model for CSBU WorkMate
form.assistantLockedExistingConversation: Ongoing conversation tasks must keep their original assistant. Create a new task to use another assistant.
form.teamTaskExecutionModeLockedReason: Team scheduled tasks must keep running in the owning team conversation, so the execution mode cannot be changed.

skill.turnIntoSkill: Turn this task into a skill
skill.saveSuccess: Skill saved — future executions will use it

error.alreadyExists: This conversation already has a scheduled task "{{name}}" (ID: {{id}}). Please update the existing task instead of creating a new one.

autopilot.title: Autopilot
autopilot.hint: Run this task unattended with guardrails. Failures go to your Inbox.
autopilot.modeBlocked: Autopilot is unavailable in {{mode}} mode: it needs a person to review each step.

guardrail.ask: Without full-auto, actions that need permission are not approved automatically.
guardrail.inbox: Failed runs show up in your Inbox.
guardrail.summary: A short run summary is sent to the channel you choose below.

yolo.title: Full-auto
yolo.hint: Off by default. When on, every action runs without asking you first.
yolo.agentCreated: This task was created by an agent, so full-auto can't be turned on.
yolo.confirmIntro: With full-auto on, this task runs on schedule with no one watching and the agent will not ask before acting. That means it may:
yolo.riskCommands: run commands and edit or delete files in the workspace without confirmation;
yolo.riskIrreversible: take actions that cannot be undone, such as sending messages or changing external services;
yolo.riskUnattended: keep repeating a wrong action on every scheduled run until you notice.
yolo.confirmOutro: Only turn this on for tasks you trust completely. You can turn it off at any time.

channel.title: Notification channel
channel.hint: Only your own connected channels are listed.
channel.empty: You have no connected channel that can receive messages. Summaries stay in the Inbox.
channel.loadFailed: Couldn't load your channels. Summaries stay in the Inbox.

error.forbidden: Not allowed: only you can turn on full-auto or turn off Autopilot, and agent-created tasks can't use full-auto.
error.invalidChannel: The selected channel can't receive messages. Pick another channel or choose None.
error.modeBlocked: Autopilot can't be used with plan or goal mode.
error.yoloNeedsAutopilot: Full-auto requires Autopilot to be on.
